title: Suntory Toki Japanese Whisky 700ml
description_en: Suntory Toki blends whiskies from Yamazaki, Hakushu, and Chita distilleries — three of Japan's most celebrated whisky houses. Delicate, sweet, with hints of basil, green apple, and honey. Perfect as a highball. Japanese whisky is ~40% cheaper in Japan.
description_ja: サントリーの山崎・白州・知多の3蒸溜所のウイスキーをブレンドしたTOKI。バジルやグリーンアップル・ハチミツのような繊細な甘みが特徴。ハイボールに最適。日本国内価格は海外より約40%安。
